doc: G17 instruction-length model, measured on an M5: ordered byte-pattern rules, then a two-level table keyed on row = b0&7 | b1.7 (move family) | b2&7 and col = b4&7 | b6&0xf | b8&7.

rules.why: 23-family register-register bitwise (bw_reg, b6 = a0/a4) is 10 bytes whatever its truth table; the table cells with b4.0 set (truth-table bit 0) said 8. Evidence: Metal emits 10-byte nor/orn/~(t|a) (own-source harvest 2026-11-25), and the M5 ran Mesa-compiled not/nor/xnor/orn as 10-byte ops (v85).
